app.title: TinyLawParody
app.intro: A tiny language model trained from scratch on Czech laws and fairy tales. Type an absurd law title (in Czech) and the model continues it in dead-serious legal style. Everything runs in your browser.

disclaimer.text: This text is machine-generated parody. It is not law, not a quotation of any law and not legal information.
about.heading: About
about.description: A model with about 10 million parameters (a small GPT-style transformer with its own tokenizer), trained from scratch on a CPU.
about.source_laws: Full texts of Czech laws (as of 21 February 2025), dataset roslein/Czech_legal_code on Hugging Face, licence GPL-3.0. The laws themselves are official works not protected by copyright.
about.source_fairy: Czech fairy tales from Czech Wikisource (cs.wikisource.org), public-domain works; for translations the translators are also in the public domain.
about.privacy: The page collects nothing and sends nothing. The model runs only in your browser. Only your language choice is stored (localStorage).
